requirements.summary: V2 has an active user-authorized goal, source-backed research report and milestone plan.
requirements.acceptance: Goal, research, plan and navigation documents agree that V2 is active and V1 remains released.

requirements.summary: Every executable command in pinned OpenTTD 15.3 is inventoried exactly once.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned-source extraction and mutation tests reject omissions, duplicates, unknown commands and sentinel drift.

requirements.summary: Base-game features, settings, native map sizes and external-AI candidates have machine dispositions.
requirements.acceptance: Feature domains, all 49 rectangles, ten AI identities and all 435 pinned-source setting definitions validate fail closed.

requirements.summary: V2 has an accepted measured decision to retain or rebase the engine source.
requirements.acceptance: Decision pins both comparison identities, patch-forward result, API drift, consequences and reversal rule.

requirements.summary: Every external-AI audit candidate is byte-locked with dependencies/licenses or truthfully rejected.
requirements.acceptance: Ten indexed outcomes revalidate as eight locks and two retained rejections with no floating content identity.

requirements.summary: Every locked audit-pool AI receives an isolated runtime qualification outcome.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned start, health, save/load, activity and resource-limit runs produce admission or machine rejection records.

requirements.summary: Competition manifests freeze slots, delays, seeds, scenarios, settings and scoring before results.
requirements.acceptance: Schema and mutations reject privilege asymmetry, missing runs, floating packages and post-result selection.

requirements.summary: The complete V1 traceability and regression suite remains mandatory in V2.
requirements.acceptance: The V2 verifier executes the unchanged V1 traceability entrypoint and propagates any failure.

requirements.summary: Native maps support every side length from 64 through 4096 and V1 32 compatibility.
requirements.acceptance: Reset tests cover the 49 native rectangles, curriculum/generalization tiers and explicit boundary policy.

requirements.summary: Variable towns, industries, companies and entity pools obey measured resource bounds.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary scenarios either run within frozen limits or fail before allocation with actionable diagnostics.

requirements.summary: Observations include deterministic multi-resolution spatial tensors.
requirements.acceptance: Independent native oracle matches channels, crops, padding, coordinate transforms and hashes across rectangular maps.

requirements.summary: Typed entity tables and transport/economy graphs have bounded versioned schemas.
requirements.acceptance: Ordering, identity, masks, truncation and overflow semantics match native slow oracles.

requirements.summary: Actions use a hierarchical parameterized schema with exact legal masks.
requirements.acceptance: Every action family, parameter domain, no-op/error outcome and command mapping passes positive/negative differential tests.

requirements.summary: Crop and candidate selection never redefine native legality.
requirements.acceptance: Slow full-map enumeration proves every exposed candidate legal and quantifies intentionally omitted legal choices.

requirements.summary: The scalable policy and checkpoint format handle variable spatial/entity inputs.
requirements.acceptance: CPU/CUDA forward, recurrent state, serialization and ONNX design pass shape, finite-value and recovery tests.

requirements.summary: Reset, step, save, load and replay remain exact at curriculum and generalization sizes.
requirements.acceptance: Seeded twin runs and save/load continuations match at the declared byte/semantic boundary.

requirements.summary: Passenger-bus competence scales through 512 and is evaluated unseen at rectangle/1024 tiers.
requirements.acceptance: Useful service and bounded-resource evidence passes without weakening the V1 passenger-bus result.

requirements.summary: Mail service and coordinated passenger/mail orders are controllable.
requirements.acceptance: Native delivery/accounting oracle proves profitable mail and coordinated mixed service without passenger regression.

requirements.summary: Truck stops, freight road vehicles and refits expose exact legality and costs.
requirements.acceptance: Build, buy, refit, order, service, replace, sell and remove actions match native behavior.

requirements.summary: Every base cargo identity and acceptance rule is represented without alias loss.
requirements.acceptance: All four climate cargo tables and station acceptance observations match pinned native source/execution.

requirements.summary: Industry production, acceptance, closure and chain edges are observable.
requirements.acceptance: Generated corpora and time-stepped oracles cover every base industry and named production chain.

requirements.summary: Subsidies, cargo distribution and economy changes are included in reward/accounting state.
requirements.acceptance: Native differential trajectories cover award, expiry, routing, payment and economy transitions.

requirements.summary: Single-leg and multi-leg production-chain planning support shared stations and transfers.
requirements.acceptance: Complete chains deliver final cargo and transfer accounting has no duplicate-payment exploit.

requirements.summary: Scenario corpora cover all four climates and their cargo graphs.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned seeds include every climate/cargo-chain class with deterministic reset and reachability validation.

requirements.summary: Every base cargo class has profitable delivery evidence with full earlier regression.
requirements.acceptance: Independent multi-seed evaluation reports delivered units, native profit, service and failure counts for every cargo class.

requirements.summary: Rail types, conversion and track construction/removal have exact action semantics.
requirements.acceptance: All orientations, slopes, junctions, crossings, ownership and cost failures match native commands.

requirements.summary: Rail stations, depots and waypoints are controllable and observable.
requirements.acceptance: Footprints, catchment, platform geometry, joining, naming and removal pass native differential tests.

requirements.summary: Train purchase, consist assembly, refit, cloning and sale are supported.
requirements.acceptance: Engine/wagon compatibility, length, capacity, cargo, cost and depot-state transitions match native execution.

requirements.summary: Path/block signals, directionality and reservations are represented exactly.
requirements.acceptance: Construction masks and time-stepped occupancy/reservation oracle cover every base signal type.

requirements.summary: Train orders, timetables, servicing, replacement and upgrades are supported.
requirements.acceptance: All order flags and lifecycle state transitions match native save/load trajectories.

requirements.summary: Observations expose junction, platform, congestion, lost-train, collision and crossing state.
requirements.acceptance: Scripted positive/negative fixtures match independent native projections at each transition.

requirements.summary: Multiple trains share signalled networks without unresolved deadlock or collision.
requirements.acceptance: Long seeded junction/platform stress runs complete service with bounded wait and zero unexplained collision.

requirements.summary: Passenger and freight rail policies achieve useful profitable service.
requirements.acceptance: Independent multi-seed evaluations beat random/trivial baselines on rail-specialist and mixed curricula.

requirements.summary: Rail evaluation includes a qualified specialist and all prior regressions.
requirements.acceptance: A qualified rail opponent has frozen solo baseline evidence and G14-G16/V1 suites remain green.

requirements.summary: Docks, ship depots and buoys have exact construction and observation semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Footprint, water adjacency, ownership, station join, cost and removal match native behavior.

requirements.summary: Natural water, rivers and navigable-region connectivity are observable.
requirements.acceptance: Slow flood-fill oracle matches region IDs, coast access, obstacles and route reachability.

requirements.summary: Canals, locks and aqueducts expose terrain/connectivity legality.
requirements.acceptance: Height, slope, span, ownership, water-class and cost positive/negative cases match native commands.

requirements.summary: Passenger/freight ships support purchase, refit, orders, service, replacement and sale.
requirements.acceptance: Vehicle lifecycle, cargo capacity, depot state and native accounting pass save/load differential tests.

requirements.summary: Sparse water routing detects and recovers from stuck or unreachable routes.
requirements.acceptance: Scripted disconnection, buoy, lock and depot cases produce bounded recovery or explicit termination.

requirements.summary: Natural-water and constructed-waterway routes achieve profitable delivery.
requirements.acceptance: Independent runs include river/sea routes plus canal, lock and aqueduct traversal with native profit parity.

requirements.summary: Ship routes participate in road/rail/water transfers without accounting exploits.
requirements.acceptance: At least one profitable multimodal transfer journey has exact cargo/payment conservation.

requirements.summary: Ship evaluation includes a qualified specialist and all prior regressions.
requirements.acceptance: Qualified ShipAI baseline and full V1/G14-G17 suites pass with retained evidence.

requirements.summary: All base airport and helicopter-facility types honor date availability and footprints.
requirements.acceptance: Build/remove masks match type, year, terrain, authority, station spread, noise and cost rules.

requirements.summary: Airplanes and helicopters expose range, capacity, refit and lifecycle semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Purchase, range mask, orders, refit, service, replacement and sale match native execution.

requirements.summary: Runway, helipad, terminal and hangar occupancy/congestion are observable.
requirements.acceptance: Time-stepped airport-state oracle matches queues, movement state and blocked capacity.

requirements.summary: Crash/disaster, airport open/close, renewal and recovery behavior is handled.
requirements.acceptance: Seeded failure fixtures produce exact events, reward/accounting transitions and bounded recovery.

requirements.summary: Unified transfer planning connects road, rail, water and air modes.
requirements.acceptance: Mode-neutral graph identities and cargo conservation pass journeys using at least three modes.

requirements.summary: A generalist router selects mode specialists through a stable shared contract.
requirements.acceptance: Router and specialists have deterministic masks/state, checkpoint recovery and no hidden privileged inputs.

requirements.summary: Airplane/helicopter routes are profitable and recover from airport congestion.
requirements.acceptance: Multi-seed evaluation reports service/profit with range/noise safety and scripted congestion recovery.

requirements.summary: Air/multimodal evaluation includes qualified opponents and all prior regressions.
requirements.acceptance: Byte-pinned Lufthansa receives a truthful qualification disposition, an active generalist is retained, and V1/G14-G18 suites pass with evidence.

requirements.summary: One RL company runs against one or many isolated NoAI companies on one map.
requirements.acceptance: Company creation/control and shared-simulation stepping pass solo, head-to-head and mixed-field integration tests.

requirements.summary: Company slot and start-delay assignment are symmetric and seeded.
requirements.acceptance: Paired manifests swap slots/delays and mutation tests reject asymmetric or post-hoc assignment.

requirements.summary: Observations expose competitor ownership, infrastructure, cargo capture and ratings without private state.
requirements.acceptance: Public-state oracle matches native visibility and negative tests reject opponent-internal leakage.

requirements.summary: Competition handles subsidies, collisions, failure, merger/purchase and shared-map resources.
requirements.acceptance: Scripted interactions match native ownership/accounting/events and have explicit reward/scoring dispositions.

requirements.summary: Opponent timeout/crash cannot corrupt, control or silently truncate the RL company.
requirements.acceptance: Fault injection contains opponent failures and emits scored machine outcomes with intact replay state.

requirements.summary: Solo, head-to-head, round-robin and mixed-field runners share one manifest contract.
requirements.acceptance: Each runner is deterministic from the same frozen scenario/package/seed identities and reports every scheduled run.

requirements.summary: Competition manifests replay deterministically at the declared semantic boundary.
requirements.acceptance: Independent replay matches settings, slots, packages, seeds, events and scores; mutations fail closed.

requirements.summary: The RL policy receives no privileged opponent or final-seed information.
requirements.acceptance: Schema review, taint-style field audit and negative tests prove only declared public observations enter inference.

requirements.summary: Tournament scoring reports service, profit, company value, survival, failures and uncertainty.
requirements.acceptance: Preregistered aggregation includes all runs/opponents, paired effects and intervals with no missing-run cherry-pick.

requirements.summary: Every qualified audit opponent receives paired multi-seed competition and solo competence is retained.
requirements.acceptance: Complete opponent matrix and solo regressions publish failures/uncertainty; universal victory is not required.

requirements.summary: All four climates and long calendar spans cover engine/facility introduction and expiry.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned scenario corpus crosses date boundaries and validates availability, obsolescence and replacement state.

requirements.summary: Local-authority actions, subsidies and exclusive rights have exact dispositions.
requirements.acceptance: Positive/negative native tests cover rating, permission, cost, award, expiry and competitor effects.

requirements.summary: Recession, inflation and other base economy transitions are observed and scored.
requirements.acceptance: Seeded time-series oracle matches native prices, production, payments and company accounting.

requirements.summary: Breakdowns, disasters and recoverable base events have explicit policy semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Enabled/disabled seeded fixtures validate event observation, damage, reward and bounded recovery.

requirements.summary: Game Script goals, questions, stories and league tables are observable/respondable.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned GS fixtures exercise every script-facing command disposition with save/load and determinism checks.

requirements.summary: A byte-pinned NewGRF pack covers tram, cargo, industries, stations, objects and all transport types.
requirements.acceptance: Full dependency/license lock and representative capability tests pass on the retained engine.

requirements.summary: Capability discovery rejects unknown or unsupported content without unsafe fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown IDs/schemas/types fail before action/inference and diagnostics list the exact incompatibility.

requirements.summary: Every feature domain and executable command disposition has non-vacuous accepted evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Machine matrix links each research row/command to executable policy/admin evidence or deliberate presentation-only proof.

requirements.summary: Broad-content coverage preserves every earlier transport, competition and V1 gate.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned content pack and base game pass full regression; no arbitrary-NewGRF universality is claimed.

requirements.summary: Trusted PPO trains across the full hierarchical multimodal curriculum.
requirements.acceptance: Finite/stable multi-seed optimization improves over random/trivial baselines with exact metric provenance.

requirements.summary: Recurrent, attention and graph state have exact rollout/checkpoint semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Sequence boundaries, masks, hidden state, reset and recovery pass CPU/CUDA differential tests.

requirements.summary: Specialist-router, monolithic and non-neural architectures have fair baselines.
requirements.acceptance: Matched training/evaluation budgets and preregistered comparisons report competence, cost and failures.

requirements.summary: CPU/CUDA batching is measured without changing simulation semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic input/output comparisons, resource telemetry and speed measurements pass declared tolerances.

requirements.summary: Long-horizon curricula control catastrophic forgetting and retain prior stages.
requirements.acceptance: Frozen stage suite runs throughout training and rejects checkpoints losing mandatory earlier competence.

requirements.summary: Checkpoint recovery is exact at the declared optimizer/environment boundary.
requirements.acceptance: Interrupted/resumed and uninterrupted trajectories match parameters, optimizer, RNG, metrics and evaluation.

requirements.summary: Independent final evaluation spans modes, climates, sizes, cargoes and opponents.
requirements.acceptance: Preregistered unseen suite uses multiple seeds and publishes every run, uncertainty and failure category.

requirements.summary: The selected generalist is profitable/service-capable in every mode with all G15-G21 regressions.
requirements.acceptance: Independent evidence—not training reward alone—passes each mode and complete retention matrix.

requirements.summary: Versioned V2 checkpoint/ONNX packages include compatibility adapters and exact identities.
requirements.acceptance: Schemas, digests, source/contracts/content/seeds and recurrent state are complete and mutation tested.

requirements.summary: Native, ONNX and in-game inference are equivalent for every architecture output/state.
requirements.acceptance: Golden and adversarial trajectories pass frozen tolerances and fail closed on incompatibility.

requirements.summary: A user can watch the V2 policy control a broad normal game against AIs.
requirements.acceptance: Visible-play campaigns cover all modes, normal UI simulation and shared-map opponents without admin shortcuts.

requirements.summary: Operator controls expose inspection, safe fallback and actionable incompatibility errors.
requirements.acceptance: Start/stop/reload, health, logs, fallback and corrupted/mismatched package cases pass visible integration tests.

requirements.summary: One guide reproduces build, train, resume, evaluate, export, install, play and tournament.
requirements.acceptance: Commands run from a clean root with only declared host prerequisites and retained outputs/digests.

requirements.summary: Release manifest, artifact index, model card, benchmark report and notices are immutable and complete.
requirements.acceptance: Every artifact/dependency/license/result is content addressed and cross-linked with no floating URL or omitted failure.

requirements.summary: Two independent clean-root reproductions match semantic and byte identities.
requirements.acceptance: Independent roots reproduce source, binaries, models, evaluation/tournament outputs and publication bundle.

requirements.summary: All mandatory V2 requirements/tests pass with zero invalidating open defects.
requirements.acceptance: Traceability/defect validators find no missing links, failed mandatory test or release-blocking nonclosed entry.

requirements.summary: The reviewed V2 bytes are tagged/published while V1 remains reproducible.
requirements.acceptance: Published tag/artifacts match accepted digests, full V2 definition of done and unchanged V1 release verification.

tests.summary: Validate and mutation-test V2 feature, command, map, source and opponent research inventory.
Regenerate, validate and mutation-test all 435 pinned OpenTTD 15.3 setting definitions and dispositions.
Review the pinned source decision and measured patch/API comparison.
Acquire/audit AI closures and validate all indexed locks/rejections.
Sandbox, start, run, save/load and activity-classify every byte-locked AI.
Run the complete released V1 traceability suite under the V2 verifier.
Mutation-test the frozen M14 competition roster, identity, fairness, seed, scoring and integrity protocol.
Validate and mutation-test scalable map, seed, resource, observation, action, model, checkpoint, ONNX design and V1 adapter contracts.
Execute and mutation-test native generation/save/load for all in-budget rectangles and preflight rejection for every over-budget rectangle.
Apply the isolated scalable-reset source delta exactly after V1, build it, and retain the result tree, executable identity and 98-test OpenTTD result.
Sandbox and mutation-test all 49 source-integrated native reset/preflight dispositions, deterministic repeat projections and variable pools.

Apply and build the isolated bounded-observation source delta; decode exact bytes independently across square, rectangular, overflow and deterministic-repeat cases; mutation-test fields, offsets, hashes and masks.

Apply and build the isolated hierarchical-action source delta; independently decode exact candidate tables, recompute masks and keys, execute every family, reject invalid typed requests without mutation, and mutation-test the evidence.
Execute all 12 hierarchical families, exact native command mappings, typed pure actions, vehicle lifecycle, and injected route rollback with zero-tick exact restoration.

Run 18 twin native episodes and exact save/load suffix replay over state, save, observation, candidate bytes and semantic fingerprints at all four curriculum and five generalization sizes through 1024x1024.
Build the native scalable policy from an immutable source tree and exercise CPU/CUDA forward, masks, gradients, recurrence, invalid inputs and exact atomic checkpoint recovery.
Deterministic useful passenger service at curriculum and held-out scales with exact twins and save/load replay.
Scalable environment, hierarchy, replay, resource and passenger competence acceptance.
Mail, truck, cargo, industry, chain, climate and accounting acceptance across 102 exact-twin cases and retained earlier regressions.
Rail construction, vehicle, signal, safety, competence and regression acceptance.
Ship, waterway, route recovery, transfer, competence and regression acceptance.
Aircraft, airport, multimodal, congestion, competence and regression acceptance.
Company competition, fairness, isolation, replay, scoring and complete opponent-matrix acceptance.
Climates, calendar, events, Game Script, NewGRF and complete command/feature disposition acceptance.
Generalist PPO, architecture, CUDA, recovery, retention and independent evaluation acceptance.
Package equivalence, visible play, documentation, clean reproduction and publication acceptance.
